convertibility_reason: No indicators used - pure price action strategy comparing previous day's open vs close. Uses only built-in MQL5 Trade library (CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CPositionInfo) for standard market orders with fixed SL/TP. Simple time-gated entry with position check. No custom indicators, no grid/martingale, no complex order management.

derived_values.name: previous_day_direction
derived_values.formula: Sign(CopyOpen(D1,1) - CopyClose(D1,1)): if Open > Close then bullish(1), if Open < Close then bearish(-1), else flat(0)

custom_logic_notes: Time-gated entry: only trades within a 300-second (5-minute) window starting at StartTimeHour:StartTimeMinute (default 00:05). The 'trade' boolean flag ensures only one trade attempt per signal window - set to true after successful order OR if a position already exists OR if D1 open==close (flat candle). No trade if current time is before the start time or more than 300 seconds after. SL/TP are 0 when input params are 0, meaning no SL/TP is set for that side.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Strategy logic: compare yesterday's D1 open vs close to determine direction, enter at a specific time window (00:05 +/- 5min) with fixed SL/TP in points. Key considerations: (1) The time window check uses server time not local time; (2) The 'trade' flag prevents multiple entries per day - reset must happen daily at the start of each new signal window; (3) Position check (Pos.Select) prevents opening if already in a position; (4) When Stop=0 or Profit=0, the corresponding level is omitted; (5) NormalizePrice is used for SL/TP levels - in Python use round(price/digits)*digits; (6) The strategy is essentially a daily reversal/follow-through depending on interpretation - buys after bearish D1 candles (open>close=red candle -> buy) and sells after bullish D1 candles (open<close=green candle -> sell), which is a mean-reversion approach.
